$comment: Ground truth for Gate 2 (DESIGN-original-workbook-and-reuse.md §5). Each pair takes a COMPLETED twin as the prior questionnaire and a different questionnaire as the new one. Written 2026-09-13 before any matcher tuning; do not edit to make a run pass.
